cases.case_label: De novo antisense SVA in exon 12 of TSC2
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous de novo ~2,957-bp antisense SVA with ~80-bp polyA and 13-bp TSD inserted in TSC2 exon 12 (patient TSC-T27), classified likely pathogenic; RNA effect not studied.
cases.quote: In TSC-T27, a de novo exonic SINE-VNTR-Alus (SVA) insertion was identified within exon 12 of TSC2 (Figure 5).

cases.case_label: De novo AluY in TSC2 intron 31 (VUS)
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous de novo antisense AluY (339-350 bp, ~50-nt polyA, 14-bp TSD) inserted 17 bp upstream of exon 32 (patient TSC-T20); in silico splicing predicted an 82-bp pseudo-exon, but RNA was not tested and the variant was classed as VUS.
cases.quote: In the TSC-T20 sample, a de novo Alu element insertion, c.4006-18_4006-17insAlu4006-17_4006-4dup, was identified within intron 31 of TSC2.
